import json, sys
try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    sys.exit("no pyyaml")
text = open("journals/2026-11-02-products-3-zero-stock-500s.md").read()
assert text.startswith("---\n")
front = text.split("\n---\n", 1)[0][4:]
core = yaml.safe_load(front)
print("YAML parses; top-level keys:", sorted(core.keys()))
try:
    import jsonschema
except ImportError:
    sys.exit("no jsonschema — YAML parse only")
schema = json.load(open("skills/investigate/journal.schema.json"))
jsonschema.validate(core, schema)
# referential integrity, scorer-style
ids = {e["id"] for e in core["evidence"]}
refs = [r for h in core["hypotheses"] for r in h["evidence_for"] + h["evidence_against"]]
missing = [r for r in refs if r not in ids]
assert not missing, missing
rc = core["root_cause"]["hypothesis"]
assert any(h["id"] == rc and h["state"] == "validated" for h in core["hypotheses"])
from datetime import datetime
s = core["investigation"]["started"]; c = core["investigation"]["concluded"]
if isinstance(s, str): s = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z","+00:00"))
if isinstance(c, str): c = datetime.fromisoformat(c.replace("Z","+00:00"))
assert int((c - s).total_seconds()) == core["usage"]["wall_clock_seconds"], (c-s)
print("schema valid; references resolve; root cause points at a validated hypothesis; wall clock matches")
EOF
